static_traits.name: Zhu Li
static_traits.family_status: Grew up in New Hampshire,immediate family members Not mentioned
static_traits.social_status: Social support is weak, but there is one close friend to confide in; dance was once her important social activity
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history;no past psychotherapy experience;no similar issue history
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly,good cooperation;able to concretely describe automatic thoughts and feelings;steady tone(Neutral attitude);has certain self-Reflection ability

basic_info.main_problem: Fear of tripping while dancing,falling and breaking the neck,thus causing paralysis;this Fear produces intense Anxiety and hesitation when dancing.
basic_info.core_demands: Hopes to regain confidence and enjoy dancing again; reduce the fear of falling and becoming paralyzed.
growth_experiences: A small fall occurred while dancing a few years ago,afterward developing catastrophic worry about 'fall-severe injury/paralysis'.Initial stress intensity was moderate,but Fear gradually developed into Anxiety and hesitation whenever dancing or thinking about dancing;especially noticeable in public or unfamiliar settings.She thus avoids certain dance steps or situations,and social and exercise habits are affected.

core_beliefs: I could suffer a serious accident and be permanently injured at any time.

special_situations.event: Preparing to dance in public or unfamiliar environments
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If dancing in public or unfamiliar settings,I am more likely to lose balance and cause irreversible harm
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to avoid dancing in public or reduces participation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will fall, break my neck, and possibly be paralyzed.

special_situations.event: When facing new or complex dance steps
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If trying complex or unfamiliar movements,I will lose control and cause serious consequences
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Only doing the simplest moves, proactively avoiding certain dance steps and scenes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: These movements are too dangerous; something will definitely happen to me.

special_situations.event: The moment of merely thinking about going to dance or starting to dance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As soon as I start dancing, disaster will happen sooner or later
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids or delays practice in advance, reducing dancing frequency
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Sooner or later I will fall and end up paralyzed.

special_situations.event: Recalling the small fall while dancing a few years ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Since I have fallen before, it means serious accidents are more likely in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Maintains hypervigilance and avoidance based on past experiences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have fallen before, which means I can easily be seriously injured again.

core_conflict.wish: Longing to freely enjoy dancing and socializing within a sense of safety,keeping the body intact and unharmed
core_conflict.fear: Fear of losing control and falling,suffering irreversible severe injury(such as paralysis)
defense_goal: Maintains safety and a sense of control by avoiding complex movements and high-risk situations

object_relations.object_representation: Others/environment as dangerous and unpredictable background

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to be in unfamiliar/public environments or to try new, more complex dance steps
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding others' advice as placing oneself at high risk,believing serious consequences are almost unavoidable('bound to happen sooner or later')
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes potential risks, frequently raises 'what if...' questions, politely but firmly narrows the task or refuses to attempt; tone is cautious, wording conservative, repeatedly expresses things such as 'I might fall'.

manifestations: Fear limiting her freedom of choice and action,avoiding dancing in public or unfamiliar environments,avoiding complex movements
Subjective experience of 'losing a part of herself'——unable to dance and socialize as freely as before
outcomes: Behavioral avoidance leads to decreased vitality and enjoyment in life

manifestations: Dance was originally an important social means; participation reduced due to fear
Social support is weak; only one close friend to confide in
outcomes: Decreased sense of connection with others,Insufficient emotional support

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains behavior originally intended toward the outside world or the urge to seek others to do something for them,redirecting energy toward the self,forming self-restraint.
manifestations: When wanting to dance, restrains the impulse to go out or participate, instead limiting oneself to only the simplest movements
Avoiding public places or unfamiliar situations for 'Self-protection'

contact_model.definition: The individual has unhealthy self-Reflection and excessive self-limitation,self-reproach,being overly careful and cautious about contact.
manifestations: In conversation I self-evaluate 'I may be overreacting', but still strictly limit my behavior
Overly focuses on potential risks; so cautious that it is hard to initiate normal contact and experience

positive_force: Has love and motivation for dance, willing to try practicing through 'small steps'
Able to see others dancing without disaster occurring,with a certain reality-testing perspective
Having a close friend available for support and Listening
No major physical illness,physically fit to participate in dancing
negative_force: Catastrophizing and predicting the future('a serious accident will happen sooner or later')
Negating positive evidence(not fallen again yet but still believing risk is certain)
Behavioral avoidance and safety-strategy dependence (avoids complex movements/public occasions)
Weak social support; limited resources make the fear harder to self-regulate

target_behavior.behavior: Strong fear of falling while dancing and suffering serious injury (such as paralysis), with behavioral avoidance
antecedent: Thinking about dancing or starting to dance
Being in public or unfamiliar settings
Facing new or complex dance steps
target_behavior.core_reason: A small fall while dancing a few years ago triggering catastrophic cognition about serious consequences,gradually Reinforced into worry about losing control and permanent injury
target_behavior.function: Escaping perceived danger and lowering current Anxiety levels
target_behavior.consequence: Avoiding dancing and specific dance steps,affected social and exercise habits;Persistent anxiety and hesitation,Decreased enjoyment of life
